ratings_why.fun: Hold or run is a real choice every turn and the shelf grows in plain sight, but the zone, seal and counting add screen load, so it stops at a happy draft.
ratings_why.distinct: Earns 8 over 7 because no tribe acts on the shop: a shelf of any tribe's units that Grisel fields as copies and Honest Ned launders into replays plays unlike every tribe today.

verdict_why: The idea is settled, but three cards have wording a player can't resolve at a glance; one short pass fixes them.

points.text: Seize should say who picks: "Seize a shop unit you choose." Also state what a bought-back unit sells for, since Contraband mixes bought and Created units with different sell prices.
Stoker of the Confiscation Fire says "one of your units" without saying chosen or random; write "a unit you choose" or "your biggest unit".
Auctioneer Ardley's "half its Attack and Health" reads as each unit's own stats; write "half the auctioned unit's Attack and Health".
Pebble Jack is a generic grow-on-play; the lookout whose juggling says the channel is clear could warn or tip off, for example acting on the shop before Nyx or Tide-Waiter Seize.

The wax seal and the stilt-house shelf carry the whole read; make the seal visible on board and shelf counts visible on the recorded board, or the Sentry, Wenna and Grisel can't be read before a fight.

standouts.why: Grisel fielding copies of everything she confiscated is the customs fantasy in one line and reads at once.
Honest Ned turning in his own crew to launder them is funny, on theme and opens replays for any tribe.
Tibby Slick's slippery dodge is short, readable and feels like an otter on a mud slide.

weakest.why: Pebble Jack's text could belong to any tribe; nothing of the lookout comes through.
Narrows Sentry is a plain count buff that adds little beyond Wenna.
Gammer Eelby's conditional gold is fiddly to track and the least visible payoff in the run lane.

flags.note: Who gains the burned stats is not stated.
"its Attack and Health" has two possible readings.
Seizing copies for free can complete triples with no gold spent.
Dunmore with a Contraband Squacco or Ned chains Seizes and replays; bounded by gold, worth the owner's eye.
